title: Endeavour Silver | Endeavour Silver Provides Update on Blockade at its Terronera Mine
summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. is a mid-tier precious metals mining company listed on the NYSE:EXK and TSX:EDR.
body_markdown:
**VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Aug. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Endeavour Silver Corp. (“Endeavour” or the “Company”) (NYSE: EXK; TSX: EDR)** provides the following update regarding the blockade and temporary suspension of operations at its Terronera mine in Jalisco, Mexico, previously announced on August 16, 2026 (see release[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=WUFHN2COfJLIEsMtqTmd7JZfx1lbCoWUj2nS2oAHkXlJiLv5qV2TrOGAFXQEg5tHNMec73_beAQ2nxtRSpVSYJkkOAgvEFvcwvmpIpnSNtTFuRT0NThwZIu9lwVVUbYjYlFZfCrt921rdTAVKfxeN51hBkEDCh5ao-hehKkyhUM=) ).


The Company continues to engage in active discussions with representatives of the nearby Ejido community. Negotiations remain ongoing and have continued in a cordial and respectful manner. At this time, there has been no material change to the status of operations at Terronera.


Endeavour remains focused on reaching a constructive resolution that supports the orderly resumption of full operations. The Company will continue to monitor the situation closely and will update the market accordingly as further developments occur.


**About Endeavour Silver –** Endeavour is a mid-tier silver producer with three operating mines in Mexico and Peru and a robust pipeline of exploration projects across Mexico, Chile, and the United States. With a proven track record of discovery, development, and responsible mining, Endeavour is driving organic growth and creating lasting value on its path to becoming a leading senior silver producer.
